fields: as a table: facts [{k, v}] (the standing rule, shown as one line over the rows), cols [supply, what we require, how we verify it], rows (cells strings or {t, link}; up to five drawn supplies, in this order), fold, fold_noun (phones only). best_for: ReceivingBench sets supplier control as a receiving bench: an isometric bench with the supplies the block lists, each tagged with its row number, and a magnifier pair that joins the pipe's lot marking to the certificate's lot line.
